impact: Deepens regulated crypto infrastructure, raising the competitive bar for HOOD's crypto custody and institutional ambitions while supporting the sector's legitimacy.
summary: Coinbase National Trust Company received full OCC approval, effective Nov 6 and announced Nov 9, covering institutional custody but not retail deposits, lending or stablecoin issuance. It follows Circle and Ripple; banking groups are challenging the OCC policy in court.
title: Coinbase wins full OCC national trust charter
